description: Download an uploaded file's content to savePath. Returns the written path and byte count; bokio_get_upload returns its metadata.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

savePath.description: File path inside BOKIO_DOWNLOAD_DIR, else the working directory; an existing file is never overwritten, so pick a new name.

uploadId.description: Id from bokio_list_uploads; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

name: bokio_download_upload
